text.p: Struthers Industries Inc said on Monday it is withholding the conversion of certain debentures to its common stock issued as part of a recent private placement, due to its suspicions of short sales by debenture holders.

"In recent months the trading of Struthers common stock ahs been under considerable pressure which management believes to have resulted in part from short-selling activities possibly perpetrated by debenture holders prior to the conversion dates," said Raoul Carroll, the Struthers chairman, in a statement released by the company.

"A true short position by these debenture holders during the restricted period and prior to a request for conversion would be a violation of the terms of the offerings and their respective subscription agreements," he added.
Struthers shares were trading at 1-23/32, up 3/32 from their Friday close.
Struthers said it has made inquiries and intends to pursue a solution, including the possibility of redeeming the debentures.
